formulas.title: How this load's numbers are calculated

commissionableBase.label: Commissionable base
commissionableBase.explanation: The carrier's gross rate minus any approved expenses marked "excluded from commission" (permits and escorts, by default). This is the amount the dispatch fee is calculated on — money that only passed through the load, like a permit fee, is never used to compute the fee.

dispatchFee.label: Dispatch fee
dispatchFee.explanation: The commissionable base multiplied by the carrier's dispatch fee percentage. This is what the carrier is invoiced for — Goliath Dispatch's charge for booking and managing the load.

netSettlement.label: Net carrier settlement
netSettlement.explanation: The carrier's gross rate, plus any approved reimbursable expenses, minus the dispatch fee, minus any carrier deductions. This is what the carrier is owed for the load.

grossMargin.label: Gross margin
grossMargin.explanation: The customer's charge minus the carrier's gross rate minus any expenses the dispatch company absorbed itself. This is the load's profit before dispatcher commission.

dispatcherCommission.label: Dispatcher commission
dispatcherCommission.explanation: The dispatcher's commission percentage applied to the chosen basis (the dispatch fee, the carrier's gross rate, or the commissionable base). This is a cost to the dispatch company — it never reduces what the carrier is paid.

expenseTreatment.excluded_from_commission_hint: Removed from the commissionable base before the dispatch fee is calculated.
expenseTreatment.reimbursable_to_carrier_hint: Added back to the carrier's settlement.
expenseTreatment.tenant_absorbed_hint: Paid by the dispatch company; reduces gross margin.
expenseTreatment.carrier_deduction_hint: Deducted from the carrier's settlement and billed on the carrier's invoice.
